title: A virtual cell foundation model for predicting context-specific perturbation responses
abstract: We introduce a virtual cell foundation model trained on diverse single-cell transcriptomic atlases. The model predicts gene expression responses to genetic perturbations across unseen cell contexts and is evaluated with held-out Perturb-seq datasets.

title: Causal gene regulatory network inference from Perturb-seq time courses
abstract: We develop a causal inference framework for reconstructing gene regulatory networks from longitudinal Perturb-seq data. Counterfactual prediction is used to separate direct regulatory effects from downstream cell-state transitions.

title: Multimodal single-cell modeling reveals drug perturbation mechanisms
abstract: A multimodal single-cell model integrates transcriptomic and chromatin measurements to predict drug perturbation outcomes. The analysis links compound response programs to candidate mechanism-of-action modules across cellular states.

title: Benchmarking single-cell transformers for zero-shot cellular response prediction
abstract: We benchmark single-cell transformer and gene language model approaches on zero-shot cellular response prediction. Results are stratified by cell type, perturbation class, and distance from the training distribution.

title: A multi-omics perturbation atlas of immune cell-state transitions
abstract: We present a multi-omics perturbation atlas combining scRNA-seq and chromatin accessibility after CRISPR screening. The atlas maps regulators of immune cell-state transitions and supports regulon analysis.

title: Mechanistic inference of compound response using interpretable cell-state models
abstract: An interpretable model connects drug response prediction to cell-state-specific regulatory programs. The study evaluates whether inferred modules recover known pharmacogenomic associations and proposes experiments for unseen compounds.

title: Whole-cell simulation with learned regulatory dynamics across environmental shifts
abstract: This whole-cell model combines learned gene regulatory dynamics with metabolic constraints. In silico cell simulations examine adaptation across environmental shifts and predict condition-specific transcriptional regulation.

title: Planning with Verifiers for Reliable Large Language Model Agents
abstract: We study language model reasoning and tool-using LLM agents with process verifiers, instruction tuning, and test-time planning across long-horizon tasks.

title: Graph RAG with Structured Knowledge Graph Reasoning
abstract: A knowledge graph retrieval augmented generation system combines entity linking, graph traversal, and knowledge graph reasoning for grounded question answering.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive World Models
abstract: We propose an offline reinforcement learning algorithm that couples model-based reinforcement learning with conservative policy optimization on heterogeneous control benchmarks.

title: Continual Learning without Catastrophic Forgetting at Scale
abstract: The continual learning method combines replay and parameter isolation for class-incremental learning, reducing catastrophic forgetting over long task sequences.

title: Self-Supervised Pretraining for General-Purpose Foundation Models
abstract: We analyze self-supervised learning objectives for foundation model pretraining and study how contrastive learning transfers across downstream domains.

title: A Unified Vision-Language Model for Multimodal Video Understanding
abstract: This multimodal learning framework aligns image-text and video-language representations in a vision-language model for perception, retrieval, and generation.
